'''Sailing''' is a tier two [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Scout]] and [[movement]] on [[Terrain|ocean]]. Sailing is an important technology for exploration and expansion, as movement on ocean makes naval units less vulnerable to attacks by land units.

In the time between the [[Path of the Ocean]] update and its successor, the Patch of the Ocean update, Sailing was briefly a tier one technology, having swapped places with [[Fishing]]. 

==Sledding==

[[Polaris]] has the '''Sledding''' technology instead of Sailing. Sledding unlocks the [[Battle Sled]].   

== Pescetism ==

[[Cymanti]] has the '''Pescetism''' technology instead of Sailing. Pescetism unlocks the [[Raychi]].

== Marine Life ==
[[Aquarion]] has the '''Marine Life''' technology instead of Sailing. Marine Life unlocks the [[Shark]].
